state.goal: Prepare an extraction checklist for ALL originals in the user's ChatGPT Library Favorites as evidence of existing musical grammar and positioning. File names and thumbnails must not control inclusion or mappings.
state.existing_model: Keep GEN/MEM/TIME/ADR/FUNC/TRN; native music carriers and generation/display/calendar order; two-turn720degree classes and lifted seams; source-qualified pitch/register locks; concurrent polarity and phase classifications; retained ratios and closure residuals. Source diagram facts, proposed model mappings, and constraints capable of discriminating existing orientations are separate evidence layers.
state.acceptance: Every original is read and source-located. Preserve legends, arrows, frame, scale, exact expressions and uncertainty. Do not invent an ontology, a final orientation or a mapping from a title.

capture_order.instructions: Which presentation order should guide the bounded extraction checklist?

criteria.literal_then_mapping: First capture literal diagram grammar and native frame, then attach explicit candidate mappings and identify orientation-discriminating constraints with their required bridge assumptions.
criteria.paired_columns: Capture literal diagram grammar and the proposed mapping in paired columns while requiring the original native frame and all bridge assumptions before using any orientation constraint.
